digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, LLM step failure reporting
propositions: Failed LLM step calls during plan-review are non-fatal by design but invisible in the verdict JSON, with no counter for survived failures

Multiple LLM call failure sites across src/rebar/llm/ swallow errors silently via logger.warning and return defaults, so an empty overlap[] from three dead batches is byte-identical to one from no matches

A new stdlib-only contextvars-based sink in src/rebar/llm/step_failures.py records failures at the single PydanticAIRunner.run seam, activated in the plan-review gate scope and drained into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty
The coverage.llm_step_failures object is present only in runs with failures, preserving byte-identity of clean runs for attestation safety, and is shaped {"total": <int>, "by_step": {<label>: <int>}}
The failure tally does not alter the verdict string, exit code, signature, or swallow behaviour of any existing site, maintaining the non-fatal semantics
